title: Honoraria Request Memo (DocuSign)
content:
DocuSign form for requesting an honorarium — a one-time payment for participation to a person who is not an employee of, and not a student of, Morgan State University. Payments must reflect market-rate limitations. International honoraria payments require guidance from MSU Accounts Payable before submission. Route the completed form via DocuSign to the MSU ORA signing group; questions to Rebecca Steiner in the Office of Research Administration, rebecca.steiner@morgan.edu or 443-885-4044.

Covers both non-Title III and Title III funded honoraria (unlike travel, which has two separate forms).

Important: oftentimes what seems like an Honorarium may actually require a Procurement or Contractual process. The ORA team is available to answer specific questions before you submit.

Questions about the DocuSign request forms go to Rebecca Steiner in the Office of Research Administration, rebecca.steiner@morgan.edu or 443-885-4044.
